messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

- Sertraline 50 mg tablets
- Sertraline 100 mg tablets
- Sertraline oral solution, 20 mg per mL
- Sertraline 150 mg capsules
- Sertraline 200 mg capsules
Capsule strengths are based on sertraline itself. A 150 mg capsule contains 168 mg of sertraline hydrochloride, and a 200 mg capsule contains 224 mg. Capsule appearance and imprints differ between manufacturers.
Triplet: ["sertraline", "has variation in appearance", "by manufacturer"]

The relation 'has variation in appearance' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug may differ in physical appearance depending on the manufacturer.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has product variation': The subject drug has a different formulation or version specified by the object entity.
B. 'manufactured by': The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.
C. 'may require dose adjustment': The subject medication might need a change in dosage under certain conditions or over time.
D. 'has brand name': The subject drug is marketed under the brand or trade name specified by the object entity.
E. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
